fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: A lancing cut that deals 18 damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Tincture Cut
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clean Lancing
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Surgeon's Margin
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. You have 10% poison resistance.
